usedFor: A successful Stripe payment creates a thank-you coupon in WooCommerce.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: A paid customer is the best time for a repeat-purchase coupon, pushed as the payment lands.

watchOut: “Create Coupon” makes a new coupon on every run, so each successful payment gets one.
